newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Hotelier, bottler take Tunis bourse index down.
newsitem.headline: Hotelier, bottler take Tunis bourse index down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down by 0.65 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 542.50 from 546.04 on Tuesday.
Volume was 2.13 million dinars against 11 million dinars.

Hotels firm Palm Beach dropped by 2.14 dinars to 9.13 dinars. Cola and beer bottler SFBT was down 1.14 dinars to 85.1. BIAT bank declined by 1.9 dinars to 30.6. Detergents firm SPCD eased 0.32 dinar to 28 dinars.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia was up 0.98 dinar to 42.98.
